Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns shown in Figure 1a indicate that the amount of NH4F used in the preparation process greatly affects crystal structure and crystallinity. Two diffraction peaks at ∼11.6° and 23.4° correspond to the (003) and (006) reflections, exhibiting the high periodicity along the c-direction, which is characteristic of NiFe LDHs (JCPDS No. 40-0215).
